commentary_title: VLGC rates weaken on lower Middle Eastern exports, increasing vessel availability in West
commentary_summary: VLGC transits rise through Cape of Good Hope; decline at the Panama Canal. | Fall in Middle Eastern exports incentivise owners to ballast vessels to the West. | Higher COGH transits improving tonne-mile demand; vessel build- up likely in the West. | No significant impact on US Gulf loadings from Hurricane Francine. | Spot rates declined 30% and 17% in the first half of the month on AG-Japan and US-Japan benchmark route.
